title: The intake hook re-files a draft that land set aside in a linked worktree outside .claude/worktrees/, since land writes under its own root and the hook reads only the main worktree's set-aside directory
goal: Found in the SP-lyfnpu37 review (bl_land.py:765 and :1395, bl_intake.py:361): land moves its own checkout's drafts to _cache/intake-drafts/ under the root it runs in, while set_aside_fingerprints reads only the clone's main worktree's _cache/intake-drafts/, so in a linked worktree outside .claude/worktrees/ the next SessionStart files the same finding again (ST-gdcn5467's clause 'files once'). A draft land sets aside in any checkout of the clone is one the hook skips.

run:
import json,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_land,bl_intake
t=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());m=t/"main";m.mkdir();g=lambda *a,c=m:s.run(["git","-C",str(c),*a],check=True,capture_output=True)
g("init","-q");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","i");g("worktree","add","-q",str(t/"linked"))
w=t/"worker";(w/"d").mkdir(parents=True);(w/"d"/"BG-x.json").write_text(json.dumps({"links":["fingerprint 0123456789ab"]}))
bl_land.set_aside_drafts(str(t/"linked"),str(w),["d/BG-x.json"])
ok="0123456789ab" in bl_intake.set_aside_fingerprints(str(t/"linked"))
print("set-aside draft seen by intake from linked worktree:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: found by reading; the case needs a linked worktree outside .claude/worktrees/ and a second SessionStart
notes: Plan SP-z3hyk4eh 2026-10-16, verified on origin/main 74c7ea6c6: bl_land.set_aside_drafts writes under its own root, bl_intake.set_aside_fingerprints reads the main worktree's. The old repro read source text; the new one sets a draft aside from a linked worktree of a temp clone and asks intake for its fingerprint (fails now). Test policy (D-6kei5o2z/D-2tq4fhgs): the named test was never written and none is added; the check is a planted run.
